asr.full_text: Your Bitcoin bonuses in the Mirror Trading International Back Office In Mirror Trading International, there are three streams of income. Firstly the bonuses you receive from daily trading. No trading knowledge is required. You join the trading pool with a minimum of a hundred dollars of Bitcoin. Your Bitcoin is traded for you from Monday to Friday. Let´s look at your Back Office Dashboard. When you look at the trading pool balance remember the idea of mirror trading international is to grow your bitcoin daily so be sure to look at the bitcoin as it will be compounding daily meaning that the percentage you earn will be from the new balance at the end of the day and not your original balance the u.s dollar value is just an indication and will fluctuate with the Bitcoin price. In your back office trading bonuses this will show you the bitcoin you have earned since you joined the trading pool To view your daily trading results you can simply click view detailed report or go to the menu on the left click on the my bonus report and the trading bonus report On this page you will see results from the daily trades and you what you have earned. You can also click on the View button on the right of the actual day to view your statement. The values on the statement are expressed in bits. Please note that 1 BTC equals 0.0000001 BTC. To get the bitcoin value divide your balance by $1, by one million. Again, don't be confused by the U.S. dollar value. Check to make sure your Bitcoin has grown from day to day. The next stream of income from MIRT is the referral bonus. If you refer other people, you will get a 10% direct referral bonus. Looking at the back office, you will see your Income wallet balance. This is the current available bonuses, which includes the pending bonuses. Click on the Includes pending bonuses to see a detailed report of all the referral bonuses that you have waiting, and the time they will be released into your Income wallet. When these are released into your wallet, you can either withdraw or reinvest into your Trading Pool. When these are released in your wallet you can either withdraw or reinvest into your trading pool. You decide either way, but try to get your Bitcoin work for you, whatever you choose to do. To see what is currently available for transfer or withdrawal from your Income Wallet, go to internal fund transfer, and this will show you your Income Wallet balance, available Income Wallet balance, pending Income Wallet balance and your pool account balance. Available Income Wallet Balance, Pending Income Wallet Balance and your Pool Account Balance. The third stream of income is the Binary Profit Sharing Bonus. You will need to be Binary-qualified to earn this bonus. This means YOU have personally introduced one person on the left and one person on the right of your business! You will also need to have at least $200 in your own position. This will qualify you for the binary bonus and you will receive a weekly binary bonus for your smallest leg. The day you sign up your second person according to the above criteria is the day you will start to benefit from those binary bonuses. Looking at your dashboard in the back office you will see the binary bonuses earned to date, and you are also able to click on the see detailed report to give you more information which will show you the value of your weakest leg and your binary bonus for that week. This bonus will be released in your Income wallet, the waiting period for the binary bonuses, just like the referral commissions, is 7 days. Finally, looking at all-time total bonuses this will show you the total of everything that has come to your income wallets to date in other words the trading bonuses referral bonuses and the binary bonuses for more information please speak to your team leader

textual.observation: The source describes joining a Bitcoin trading pool with a minimum contribution while stating that trading is done for the participant and that no trading knowledge is required.

evidence.quote: Firstly the bonuses you receive from daily trading. No trading knowledge is required. You join the trading pool with a minimum of a hundred dollars of Bitcoin. Your Bitcoin is traded for you from Monday to Friday.

textual.context: The ASR presents this as an explanation of Mirror Trading International's back-office trading-pool program; no independent performance evidence or risk disclosure is supplied.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated daily-trading bonus/return is linked to contributing at least one hundred dollars of Bitcoin to a pool managed by others.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish actual deposits, trading activity, returns, ownership, platform legitimacy, or whether viewers are being directly solicited.

textual.observation: The source instructs viewers to check whether their Bitcoin balance has grown daily and says the balance compounds based on the end-of-day balance.

evidence.quote: remember the idea of mirror trading international is to grow your bitcoin daily so be sure to look at the bitcoin as it will be compounding daily meaning that the percentage you earn will be from the new balance at the end of the day and not your original balance

textual.context: This is presented as an explanation of how reported trading-pool balances and earnings are displayed in a back office.
textual.potential_relevance: The source connects a claim of daily Bitcoin growth and compounding to the reported balance used to calculate earnings.
textual.limitations: The records do not provide a promised rate, guarantee, trading results independent of the platform, or evidence that any balance growth occurred.

textual.observation: The source states that referring people produces a 10% direct referral bonus and that released bonuses can be withdrawn or reinvested into the trading pool.

evidence.quote: people, you will get a 10% direct referral bonus.
When these are released into your wallet, you can either withdraw or reinvest into your Trading Pool.

textual.context: The ASR describes referral bonuses and wallet options as features of the stated program; it does not identify referral recipients or demonstrate withdrawals.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated 10% reward is tied to referring other people, and the described reward flow includes reinvestment into the trading pool.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether referrals occurred, how the bonus is calculated or funded, or whether withdrawals are available in practice.

textual.observation: The source says eligibility for a weekly binary bonus requires personally introducing one person on each side of a business structure and maintaining at least $200 in one's own position.

evidence.quote: This means YOU have personally introduced one person on the left and one person on the right of your business! You will also need to have at least $200 in your own position. This will qualify you for the binary bonus and you will receive a weekly binary bonus for your smallest leg.

textual.context: The ASR presents the recruitment and position-balance requirements as qualifications for a binary profit-sharing bonus.
textual.potential_relevance: The stated weekly reward is expressly conditional on both recruiting two people into a left/right structure and holding at least $200 in one's own position.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish the meaning of a position, whether participants paid the stated amount, the value of bonuses, or actual recruitment outcomes.

visual.observation: A presentation slide states that viewers can join a trading pool with a minimum of $100 in Bitcoin, after which their Bitcoin is traded for them from Monday to Friday.
visual.context: Presented as an explanation of a Bitcoin trading-pool arrangement associated with Mirror Trading International.
visual.potential_relevance: A requested Bitcoin contribution is linked to a claimed managed-trading outcome, creating a payment-and-return relationship that may merit conditional review.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether the service operated as described, whether funds were transferred, or whether any return was received.

visual.observation: Slides describe a 10% referral bonus and state that binary qualification requires introducing one person on each side of the business and maintaining at least $200 in the participant's own position.
visual.context: Presented as an explanation of the program's referral and binary-bonus structure.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised bonus is explicitly linked to recruiting two people and maintaining a monetary position, which is a task-relevant recruitment-and-payment relationship.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether the bonus was paid, how qualification was enforced, or whether participants experienced a loss.

visual.observation: A slide states that referral and binary bonuses have a 7-day waiting period; another instructs viewers to click an 'Includes Pending' area to view referral bonuses expected in the next 7 days.
visual.context: Presented as program-account instructions and timing conditions for pending bonuses.
visual.potential_relevance: The promised bonus is tied to a specified waiting period and an account interaction to view pending amounts, making the benefit conditional on stated program procedures.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show whether clicking occurred, whether the amounts became available, or what additional conditions applied.

visual_context_notes.observation: The material uses the name 'Mirror Trading International' and shows a back-office dashboard with team-member counts, referrals, Bitcoin balances, trading bonuses, and wallet balances.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes a managed Bitcoin trading pool requiring at least $100 while presenting trading as requiring no knowledge and describing daily growth and compounding. It also offers a 10% referral reward and a weekly binary bonus tied to recruiting one person on each side and maintaining at least $200 in one's own position. Back-office screens and seven-day bonus timing present these as operational program benefits, though the available video evidence does not establish whether deposits, trades, withdrawals, or returns occurred.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker presents joining a Bitcoin trading pool with a minimum contribution as the basis for managed trading and daily compounding returns. The same offer also describes a distinct binary-team income structure tied to recruiting people on left and right legs.

evidence.observation: The speaker connects left/right recruitment and a personal position requirement to a weekly binary bonus.
